environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in 'application' namespace on shared EKS cluster with Istio sidecar injected. The Istio installation uses PERMISSIVE mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication set to PERMISSIVE at mesh level). No AuthorizationPolicy resources are applied to the application namespace. The Fargate task's security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). The ALB target group routes /internal/* paths without any authentication header requirements. Container runs with task role that has no restrictions on outbound network (for XXE SSRF to metadata service at 169.254.170.2).
